role: slides 1-14 assembly narration and production brief
family_bridge: The first 14 slides move from why the benchmark is needed, to how public studies become mission-held-out tasks, to what feature layers the models see, and finally to the completed result spine with robustness, guardrails, limitations, biological hypotheses, and translation boundaries.

compression_decision.default_14_slide_path: Use B1 as slide 4 with B2 in notes; use B3 as slide 5 with B4 in notes; use feature-layer bridge as slide 6.
compression_decision.expanded_methods_option: If the talk focus is methodology, split B2 and B4 into visible slides and shift the result spine later.
compression_decision.risk: Over-expanding methods can delay the first result; over-compressing methods can make AUROC slides feel unearned.

slides.title: SpaceBio-Bench
slides.headline: Testing biological AI under spaceflight domain shift
slides.caption: Open with the platform thesis and the mission-held-out problem before any model score appears.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not claim first AI benchmark for space biology.

slides.title: External gap
slides.headline: Distinct niche, not a firstness claim
slides.caption: Show the external landscape while keeping the claim to a distinct mission-held-out GeneLab/OSDR benchmark niche.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not overstate novelty against NASA BPS, GLARE, OpenProblems, or cell-eval.

slides.title: Project evolution
slides.headline: v1-v9 moves from benchmark results to platform
slides.caption: Orient the audience: v1-v7 are completed benchmark results, v8 is hypothesis-only translation, and v9 is platformization.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not present all v1-v9 outputs as equal-strength scientific discoveries.

slides.title: Evaluation layer
slides.headline: Public studies become auditable tasks
slides.status: dark asset ready; B2 in notes
slides.caption: B1 carries the visible slide; B2 supplies the task-unit explanation in speaker notes or backup.
slides.claim_boundary: Conceptual bridge, not quantitative result evidence.

slides.title: Mission-held-out guard
slides.headline: The hidden test set is an entire mission
slides.status: dark asset ready; B4 in notes
slides.caption: B3 carries the visible split; B4 supplies the train-only guardrail in speaker notes or backup.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not call this random cross-validation or unqualified independent validation.

slides.title: Feature layers
slides.headline: What the model sees can change
slides.caption: Explain gene-level and pathway-summary views before tissue and model score results.
slides.claim_boundary: Schematic methods bridge, not a quantitative result figure.

slides.title: Tissue hierarchy
slides.headline: Cross-mission transfer is tissue-specific
slides.caption: Start the result core with the main tissue-dependence finding.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not imply one tissue result generalizes to all tissues.

slides.title: Pathway rescue
slides.headline: Pathway summaries can rescue selected weak tasks
slides.caption: Use this after tissue hierarchy so feature abstraction has a visible payoff.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not claim pathway features always outperform gene-level models.

slides.title: Model comparison
slides.headline: Scale alone does not solve transfer
slides.caption: Place model comparison after task and feature logic are clear.
slides.claim_boundary: Do not universalize foundation-model failure beyond tested settings.

slides.title: v4 hardening
slides.headline: Broader grid reduces cherry-pick risk
slides.caption: This is the first hardened result after early tissue/pathway/model findings.
slides.claim_boundary: Hardening and coverage evidence only; not a new leaderboard.

slides.title: Temporal and RRRM
slides.headline: Timepoint labels need guardrails
slides.caption: Adds preservation, recovery, and single-cell pilot guardrails before interpretation.
slides.claim_boundary: Recovery projection is descriptive; RRRM composition is underpowered.

slides.title: Negative boundary
slides.headline: Negative results set boundaries
slides.caption: Make failure modes part of benchmark value before moving into biology.
slides.claim_boundary: No universal absence-of-biology or universal model-failure claim.

slides.title: Biological interpretation
slides.headline: Hits become hypotheses
slides.caption: Interpret bounded signals as immune, metabolic, and biomarker hypotheses.
slides.claim_boundary: Interpretation and target triage only; no treatment or mechanism proof.

slides.title: Human translation
slides.headline: Translation is partial, not direct
slides.caption: Close the completed result core with a boundary-aware human-alignment slide.
slides.claim_boundary: No direct gene-transfer, clinical, or countermeasure claim.
